name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move' is correctly ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) hard — 'very next move' demands the next-step consequent, and holding_box on the step after a fall is the right encoding of picking it up since the fall empties the hands. 'If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box' is correctly Response(at_exit, holding_box) hard with no Existence(at_exit): reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if', and the Response is owed on that last step, failing if the episode ends without the box. Both clauses are hard as worded ('must', no preference cue), all propositions are declared, and the rule-only warning is valid because the task contains only 'each time' and 'if' consequents with no unconditional goal.

texts: Every time the box falls, the agent must be holding the box on the very next step.
If the agent reaches the exit, the agent must be holding the box at that moment.
